Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 5
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner accepted the Wikipedia lead sentence stating Vincent Novello was “born in Piedmont, Italy” without reconciling the clear contradiction on the same page’s “Life” section, which says he was born at 240 Oxford Street, London. This misreading of the source could lead to the wrong birthplace (Piedmont) instead of the correct one (London, England).
